note: CC0 photo scans for the ground detail (docs/22), fetched by tools/texture-lab.html straight from Poly Haven at 1k. Maps: diff (albedo), nor_gl (OpenGL normal), rough, disp (height), ao (cavity). Packed results live in assets/textures/ground/<material>/<size>/a|b|c.webp.
webpNote: 1.0 makes Chrome write lossless WebP. b (normals, roughness) is lossless because lossy 4:2:0 WebP bleeds channels into the normals (mean error about 5/255, up to 42); a and c tolerate lossy.
